_comment: Final bounded B112 M-to-M setup attempt. It acknowledges the Conflict timeout pager, wishes a cockatrice corpse, then tries to step west before the C-bound Ctrl-D kick command and creates a hostile sandestin plus a newt. C shows the hero already on the westmost interior tile with a wall to the west; the step does not move, and the later eastward kick reports empty space. Thus mattackm never sees a wielded petrifying corpse and uhitm.c:do_stone_mon is not reached. Preserve this recipe as a source-traced setup miss; do not treat it as a matching recording.
